lines.text: Hi, I'm Dr. Afya. Here's how AfyaConnect works.
We help you see a specialist, and keep your whole care journey in one place.
One. Register with your phone number and ID. It takes about two minutes.
Two. Choose a verified specialist, pick a time, and send your booking request.
Three. Your doctor confirms, and you both get the video link, with reminders by text message and in the app.
Four. After your visit, the summary and your prescription are added to your health record.
A doctor can open your file only after confirming your booking, and you can turn that off at any time.
Five. We keep reminding you until you choose the pharmacy you prefer.
You will find everything in these tabs: Home, Appointments, Health record, and your care plan.
Ready? Tap Create your account. See you inside!
